desc:
Welcome to +1 Dragon Evolution, the anime dragon fighting game where you get +1 Ki every second!
Train, evolve your power, transform and become the strongest dragon warrior in the universe.

NEW WORLD 3: Planet Nemek is open!
- 50 new stages (101-150) against the tyrant's invasion army
- The toughest bosses yet: only the strongest warriors survive
- 14 new warrior skins with bigger auras
- New World 3 leaderboard: climb to the top!

Fight through 150 stages on 3 planets: Earth, Saiya and Nemek.
Get a squad, roll powerful skills, Fusion with your squad and Rebirth for even more Ki.
Play with friends for up to +50% Power!

Premium benefit: Premium players get +10% Power.

Like the game and join the group for more updates and new planets!
